account.title: BetInsight – Account & Access
account.heading: Your BetInsight Account Hub
account.lead: Open your personal area without searching for an access code. If your access is already saved on this device, you can continue directly. Otherwise, we will send your personal access link to your registered email address.
account.settingsCopy: Here you can view the email address stored with Systeme.io and manage your account settings or password.
account.dashboardCopy: If your personal access is already saved on this device, your dashboard will open directly.
account.accessCopy: You do not need to know or copy any technical code. BetInsight only checks whether personal access is already stored on this device. If it is missing, you can request your existing access link using your registered email address.
account.statusSaved: ✅ Your personal BetInsight access is saved on this device.
account.statusMissing: ℹ️ No personal access is saved on this device yet. Request it by email below.
account.emailTitle: Sign in with your registered email
account.emailCopy: Enter the same email address used to register your BetInsight account. For security reasons, this page does not reveal whether a specific address is registered with us.
account.privacyNote: Your personal access link is sent only to the registered email inbox. Knowing an email address alone does not provide access to the account.
account.registrationCopy: Start on the public BetInsight website. Any existing referral code will be carried over automatically.
account.fineprint: © 2026 BetInsight · Your personal dashboard access is never displayed publicly.
account.targetNote: After successful access, you will automatically continue to: {{target}}.
account.targetCopy: If your personal access is already saved on this device, we will open this area directly.
account.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
account.requestSuccess: ✅ If the email address is registered, your personal access link has been sent. Open the link on this device; your access will then be saved automatically.
account.requestError: The access link could not be requested right now. Please try again in a moment.
account.networkPending: Secure access to Premium & Network is currently being migrated to a handoff that does not expose dashboard access in the browser address bar. For now, please open this area from the dashboard.

exchangePage.title: BetInsight Unit Exchange
exchangePage.heading: Unit Exchange
exchangePage.intro: Buy available Referral Units or offer your released Units for sale to other BetInsight members.
exchangePage.buyCopy: View available sale offers and choose an offer.
exchangePage.sellCopy: Create a new sale offer using released Referral Units.
exchangePage.myOffersCopy: View your currently active offers or offers reserved by a buyer.
exchangePage.walletCopy: Manage your USDT/USDC wallet for direct incoming payments.
exchangePage.info: Only Units specifically released for sale can be sold.
exchangePage.missingAccess: No valid dashboard access is stored on this device yet. Please open the Unit Exchange from your current BetInsight profile.

walletPage.title: Wallet Management | BetInsight Club
walletPage.heading: Wallet Management
walletPage.intro: Store one personal receiving address. This wallet will later be used for your sales on the BetInsight Unit Exchange.
walletPage.noticeTitle: Use only your own self-custody wallet
walletPage.noticeCopy: Do not use a deposit address from a crypto exchange such as Binance, Coinbase, Bitpanda or Kraken. BetInsight will never ask for your seed phrase or private key.
walletPage.savedNote: If you save a different wallet below, your previous wallet will be replaced and the change will be recorded in the wallet history.
walletPage.oneActive: Each user can have only one active address.
walletPage.examplesDefault: Select a cryptocurrency and network first.
walletPage.addressHelp: Copy the address directly from your wallet. Check the first and last characters carefully.
walletPage.ownConfirm: I confirm that this is my own public receiving address from a self-custody wallet and not a deposit address from a crypto exchange.
walletPage.networkConfirm: I have checked the cryptocurrency, network and full address. I understand that using the wrong network can result in loss of funds.
walletPage.examples: Suitable wallet examples: TronLink or TokenPocket.
walletPage.tronError: A TRON address normally starts with T and contains 34 characters.
walletPage.missingAccess: Your personal dashboard access is missing. Please open Wallet Management from your BetInsight profile.
walletPage.legacyType: The currently saved wallet uses a payment type that is no longer offered for new sales. Select USDT – TRON or TRX – TRON if you want to change it.
walletPage.selectError: Please select a cryptocurrency and network first.
walletPage.addressError: Please enter your public receiving address.
walletPage.sent: Your wallet data was securely transferred to BetInsight.
walletPage.failed: The transfer failed. Please try again.

unlockedPage.title: BetInsight – Unlocked Tips
unlockedPage.heading: ✅ Unlocked Tips
unlockedPage.subtitle: Your unlocked tips and, once confirmed by the master system, the corresponding result.
unlockedPage.upgradeDefault: Premium gives you additional provider and odds information.
unlockedPage.premiumBenefit: ⭐ Premium: 2 providers and odds for the unlocked tip – without a direct provider link.
unlockedPage.plusBenefit: ✨ Premium Plus: up to 5 providers and odds plus approved direct provider/affiliate links.
unlockedPage.affiliate: Advertising notice: BetInsight may receive a commission when marked provider links lead to a registration or use of the provider.
unlockedPage.noAccess: No personal dashboard access was found. Please open this page from your BetInsight profile.
unlockedPage.empty: You have not unlocked any tips yet.
unlockedPage.providerNote: Premium: 2 providers/odds without direct links · Premium Plus: all 5 plus approved direct/affiliate links.
unlockedPage.slotReady: This slot is enabled for your plan. The provider and current odds will appear here once they are stored for this tip or supplied by the API.
unlockedPage.upgradePlus: This provider slot belongs to Premium Plus. Upgrading unlocks up to 5 providers/odds and approved direct provider links.
unlockedPage.upgradePremium: This provider slot is available from Premium. Premium shows 2 providers/odds; Premium Plus extends the comparison to up to 5 providers and approved direct links.
unlockedPage.resultPending: The result will be shown only after confirmation by BetInsight.
unlockedPage.noAnalysis: No analysis is available for this entry.

tipsPage.title: BetInsight Tips
tipsPage.heading: BetInsight Tips
tipsPage.subtitle: Here you can find the current BetInsight tips. Once BetInsight confirms a result, the tip is automatically moved to “Completed Tips & Results”.
tipsPage.openCopy: Here you can find all currently open tips that can still be unlocked.
tipsPage.resultsCopy: See all results confirmed by BetInsight at a glance.
tipsPage.invalidJson: The server response is not valid JSON.
tipsPage.noResults: No confirmed results are available yet.
tipsPage.revealNote: After unlocking, the match, market, selection, exact odds, kickoff, tipster and analysis will become visible.
